summary: BetterLife Pharma, a TSX-V/OTC-listed Canadian pharma, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a Material Change Report disclosing the August 2026 appointment of Charles Duncan, PhD as director and audit committee chair, plus option grants of 500,000 shares at $0.285 (24-month quarterly vesting) and 125,000 at $0.285 (three-month vesting), both ten-year terms. The company also reported $127,500 gross proceeds from exercise of 850,000 warrants at $0.15 per share between September 1-10, 2026, for BETR-001 development and working capital, and adoption of an amended long-term incentive plan. No board recommendation or advisor named; no acquisition, tender, or strategic transaction terms stated. This is a routine governance and capital-formation disclosure, not a special situation; watch for warrant overhang and insider alignment rather than deal arbitrage.
